Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* #5396
* __->__ #5395
* #5265
* #5264
* #5261
* #5259
* #5258

Fuse BF16 input conversion, TF32 GEMMs and BF16 output casts into one
CuTeDSL kernel per gradient. Preserve the pinned fbpackage gate policy,
forward and FSDP ownership. Use names distinct from the HiMidLo override.

GB300 [4096,7168] -> 256, native -> fused:
backward 179.37 -> 144.09 us; F+loss+B 216.46 -> 172.53 us;
peak allocated 310.50 -> 163.00 MiB. Bitwise and FSDP128 checks pass.
Keep default-off: 23.3% of the calibrated roofline, below the 90% gate.

One self-contained override, one CPU test file and one GPU test file.
The pinned runtime passes 39 tests; public main imports safely and
reports the missing native TF32 policy rather than substituting HiMidLo.

+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch._subclasses.fake_tensor import FakeTensorMode
+from torch.fx.experimental.proxy_tensor import make_fx
+
+from torchtitan.config import apply_overrides, Configurable, OverrideConfig
+from torchtitan_recipes.overrides import fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32 as fusion
+
+
+_HAS_NATIVE_GATE = fusion.RouterGateLinear is not None and fusion._NATIVE_MM is not None
+_requires_native = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _HAS_NATIVE_GATE, reason="The native TF32 gate belongs to the pinned fbpackage"
+)
+
+
+def _config(*, bias=False):
+    from torchtitan.models.common.router_gate import RouterGateLinear, RouterGemmConfig
+
+    return RouterGateLinear.Config(
+        in_features=7168,
+        out_features=256,
+        bias=bias,
+        forward=RouterGemmConfig(
+            input_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            compute_mode="bf16",
+            output_dtype=torch.float32,
+        ),
+        backward=RouterGemmConfig(
+            input_dtype=torch.float32,
+            compute_mode="tf32",
+            output_dtype=torch.float32,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def test_missing_native_tf32_policy_is_explicit():
+    with patch.object(fusion, "_NATIVE_MM", None):
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="pinned fbpackage"):
+            fusion.fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32(None, experimental=True)
+
+
+def test_fake_operators_keep_bf16_gradients_and_distinct_names():
+    with patch.object(
+        fusion, "_CUTEDSL_IMPORT_ERROR", ImportError("unavailable")
+    ), FakeTensorMode():
+        gradient_TE = torch.empty((4096, 256), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+        weight_ED = torch.empty((256, 7168), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        input_TD = torch.empty((4096, 7168), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+
+        def backward(gradient_TE, weight_ED, input_TD):
+            return fusion.dgrad_op(gradient_TE, weight_ED), fusion.wgrad_op(
+                gradient_TE, input_TD
+            )
+
+        grad_input_TD, grad_weight_ED = backward(gradient_TE, weight_ED, input_TD)
+        assert grad_input_TD.shape == input_TD.shape
+        assert grad_weight_ED.shape == weight_ED.shape
+        assert grad_input_TD.dtype == grad_weight_ED.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        assert grad_input_TD.is_contiguous() and grad_weight_ED.is_contiguous()
+        graph = make_fx(backward)(gradient_TE, weight_ED, input_TD)
+        assert [
+            str(node.target) for node in graph.graph.nodes if node.op == "call_function"
+        ] == [
+            "torchtitan.dsv3_router_gate_tf32_dgrad.default",
+            "torchtitan.dsv3_router_gate_tf32_wgrad.default",
+        ]
+        assert not fusion._supports_gate_backward(gradient_TE, weight_ED, wgrad=False)
+
+
+@_requires_native
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("experimental", [False, True])
+def test_override_preserves_native_policy_and_state(experimental):
+    config = _config(bias=True)
+    with pytest.warns(UserWarning, match="roofline acceptance"):
+        replacement = fusion.fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32(
+            config, experimental=experimental
+        )
+    assert not fusion.ACCEPTED
+    assert replacement.use_fused_backward is experimental
+    assert replacement.forward == config.forward
+    assert replacement.backward == config.backward
+    with torch.device("meta"):
+        native = config.build()
+        candidate = replacement.build()
+    assert (
+        list(native.state_dict()) == list(candidate.state_dict()) == ["weight", "bias"]
+    )
+    assert native.weight.shape == candidate.weight.shape == (256, 7168)
+
+
+@_requires_native
+def test_override_selects_moe_gates_without_replacing_other_linears():
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class RouterConfig(Configurable.Config):
+        gate: Configurable.Config
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class MoEConfig(Configurable.Config):
+        router: RouterConfig
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class LayerConfig(Configurable.Config):
+        moe: MoEConfig
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class ModelConfig(Configurable.Config):
+        layer: LayerConfig
+        lm_head: Configurable.Config
+
+    root = ModelConfig(
+        layer=LayerConfig(moe=MoEConfig(router=RouterConfig(gate=_config()))),
+        lm_head=_config(),
+    )
+    lm_head = root.lm_head
+    with pytest.warns(UserWarning, match="roofline acceptance"):
+        replaced = apply_overrides(
+            OverrideConfig(
+                imports=[
+                    (
+                        "torchtitan_recipes.overrides.fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32.fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32",
+                        {"experimental": True},
+                    )
+                ]
+            ),
+            root,
+        )
+    assert len(replaced) == 1
+    assert isinstance(root.layer.moe.router.gate, fusion.FusedDSv3TF32RouterGate.Config)
+    assert root.layer.moe.router.gate.use_fused_backward
+    assert root.lm_head is lm_head

+# Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
+# All rights reserved.
+#
+# This source code is licensed under the BSD-style license found in the
+# LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+
+import gc
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from dataclasses import replace
+from functools import partial
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch.distributed.device_mesh import init_device_mesh
+from torch.distributed.fsdp import MixedPrecisionPolicy
+from torch.testing._internal.distributed.fake_pg import FakeStore
+from torch.utils._python_dispatch import TorchDispatchMode
+from torch.utils._pytree import tree_leaves
+from torch.utils.checkpoint import checkpoint
+
+from torchtitan_recipes.overrides import fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32 as fusion
+
+from tests.unit_tests.cpu.test_fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32 import _config
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    fusion.RouterGateLinear is None
+    or fusion._NATIVE_MM is None
+    or fusion._CUTEDSL_IMPORT_ERROR is not None
+    or torch.__version__ != "2.15.0a0+giteecfcac"
+    or not torch.cuda.is_available()
+    or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != (10, 3)
+    or os.environ.get("NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE") == "0",
+    reason="Pinned fbpackage TF32 gate on GB300",
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _deterministic():
+    previous = torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled()
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
+    yield
+    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(previous)
+
+
+def _operands(seed=42):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    activation = torch.randn((4096, 7168), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    weight = torch.randn((256, 7168), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 64
+    gradient = torch.randn((4096, 256), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    return gradient, weight, activation
+
+
+def bitwise_differences(expected, actual):
+    assert expected.shape == actual.shape and expected.dtype == actual.dtype
+    return int(
+        (
+            expected.contiguous().view(torch.uint8)
+            != actual.contiguous().view(torch.uint8)
+        ).sum()
+    )
+
+
+def native_pair(gradient, weight, activation):
+    activation = activation.detach().requires_grad_()
+    weight = weight.detach().requires_grad_()
+    logits = fusion._RouterGateLinearFunction.apply(
+        activation, weight, "bf16", torch.float32, torch.float32, "tf32", torch.float32
+    )
+    return torch.autograd.grad(logits, (activation, weight), gradient)
+
+
+def fused_pair(gradient, weight, activation):
+    return (fusion.dgrad_op(gradient, weight), fusion.wgrad_op(gradient, activation))
+
+
+def exact_pair(expected, actual):
+    assert len(expected) == len(actual)
+    differences = [
+        bitwise_differences(left, right) for left, right in zip(expected, actual)
+    ]
+    assert differences == [0] * len(expected), differences
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("seed", [0, 42, 20261009])
+def test_native_function_parity_and_repeatability(seed):
+    values = _operands(seed)
+    expected = native_pair(*values)
+    exact_pair(expected, native_pair(*values))
+    exact_pair(expected, fused_pair(*values))
+    assert all((torch.count_nonzero(value) > 0 for value in expected))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "pattern",
+    [
+        "cancellation",
+        "magnitudes",
+        "tf32_ties",
+        "bf16_ties",
+        "signed_zero",
+        "subnormal",
+        "nonfinite",
+        "nonfinite_inputs",
+        "bf16_subnormal_inputs",
+    ],
+)
+def test_numeric_boundaries(pattern):
+    gradient, weight, activation = _operands()
+    if pattern == "cancellation":
+        weight[1::2].copy_(weight[::2])
+        activation[1::2].copy_(activation[::2])
+        gradient[:, 1::2] = -gradient[:, ::2]
+        gradient[1::2] = -gradient[::2]
+        gradient[::16, ::16] *= 1.0009765625
+    elif pattern == "magnitudes":
+        for value in (gradient, weight, activation):
+            exponent = torch.randint(-60, 61, value.shape, device="cuda")
+            value.copy_(torch.ldexp(value.float(), exponent))
+    elif pattern == "tf32_ties":
+        bits = torch.tensor(
+            [
+                1065357311,
+                1065357312,
+                1065357313,
+                1065365503,
+                1065365504,
+                1065365505,
+                -1082126336,
+                -1082118144,
+            ],
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device="cuda",
+        ).view(torch.float32)
+        gradient.copy_(bits.repeat(gradient.numel() // len(bits)).view_as(gradient))
+    elif pattern == "bf16_ties":
+        activation.zero_()
+        activation[0].fill_(1)
+        weight.zero_()
+        weight[0].fill_(1)
+        gradient.zero_()
+        midpoint = torch.tensor(
+            [1.00390625, 1.01171875, -1.00390625, -1.01171875], device="cuda"
+        )
+        below = torch.nextafter(midpoint, torch.full_like(midpoint, -torch.inf))
+        above = torch.nextafter(midpoint, torch.full_like(midpoint, torch.inf))
+        neighbors = torch.cat((below, midpoint, above))
+        gradient[:, 0] = neighbors.repeat(342)[:4096]
+        gradient[0] = neighbors.repeat(22)[:256]
+    elif pattern == "signed_zero":
+        gradient.zero_()
+        gradient[:, ::2] = -0.0
+    elif pattern == "subnormal":
+        bits = torch.tensor(
+            [
+                1,
+                4096,
+                4194304,
+                8388607,
+                8388608,
+                8392704,
+                -2147483647,
+                -2147479552,
+                -2143289344,
+                -2139095041,
+                -2139095040,
+                -2139090944,
+            ],
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device="cuda",
+        ).view(torch.float32)
+        gradient.copy_(
+            bits.repeat((gradient.numel() + 11) // 12)[: gradient.numel()].view_as(
+                gradient
+            )
+        )
+        activation.fill_(1)
+        weight.fill_(1)
+    elif pattern == "nonfinite":
+        gradient[::8, 0] = torch.inf
+        gradient[1::8, 0] = -torch.inf
+        gradient[2::8, 0] = torch.nan
+        gradient.view(torch.int32)[3::8, 0] = 2141266757
+    elif pattern == "nonfinite_inputs":
+        activation.view(torch.int16)[::8, ::8] = 32705
+        weight.view(torch.int16)[::8, ::8] = -63
+        gradient.view(torch.int32)[::8, ::8] = 2141266757
+        activation[1::8, 1::8] = torch.inf
+        weight[1::8, 1::8] = -torch.inf
+    elif pattern == "bf16_subnormal_inputs":
+        bits = torch.tensor(
+            [1, 2, 127, 128, -32767, -32766, -32641, -32640],
+            dtype=torch.int16,
+            device="cuda",
+        )
+        for value in (activation, weight):
+            value.view(torch.int16).copy_(
+                bits.repeat(value.numel() // 8).view_as(value)
+            )
+        gradient[:, ::2] *= -1
+    values = (gradient, weight, activation)
+    exact_pair(native_pair(*values), fused_pair(*values))
+
+
+class Operations(TorchDispatchMode):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.names = []
+
+    def __torch_dispatch__(self, function, types, args=(), kwargs=None):
+        self.names.append(str(function))
+        return function(*args, **kwargs or {})
+
+
+def models(config=None, *, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+    config = _config() if config is None else config
+    native = config.build().to(device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    fused = (
+        fusion.fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32(config, experimental=True)
+        .build()
+        .to(device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    )
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        native.weight.normal_(std=0.015625)
+    fused.load_state_dict(native.state_dict())
+    return (native, fused)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32])
+def test_module_forward_gradients_accumulation_and_dispatch(dtype):
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    gates = models(dtype=dtype)
+    _, _, values = _operands()
+    values = values.view(1, 4096, 7168)
+    upstreams = [torch.randn((1, 4096, 256), device="cuda") for _ in range(3)]
+    previous_weight_grad = torch.randn_like(gates[0].weight)
+    previous_activation_grad = torch.randn_like(values)
+    snapshots = []
+    for gate in gates:
+        activation = values.clone().requires_grad_()
+        activation.grad = previous_activation_grad.clone()
+        gate.weight.grad = previous_weight_grad.clone()
+        operations = Operations()
+        steps = []
+        with operations:
+            for upstream in upstreams:
+                logits = gate(activation)
+                logits.backward(upstream)
+                steps.extend(
+                    [
+                        logits.detach().clone(),
+                        activation.grad.clone(),
+                        gate.weight.grad.clone(),
+                    ]
+                )
+        for suffix in ("dgrad", "wgrad"):
+            assert operations.names.count(
+                f"torchtitan.dsv3_router_gate_tf32_{suffix}.default"
+            ) == (3 if gate is gates[1] else 0)
+        snapshots.append(steps)
+    exact_pair(*snapshots)
+    assert list(gates[0].state_dict()) == list(gates[1].state_dict()) == ["weight"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "need_input,need_weight", [(False, True), (True, False), (True, True)]
+)
+def test_partial_gradients(need_input, need_weight):
+    gradient, weight, activation = _operands()
+    results = []
+    for function in (
+        fusion._RouterGateLinearFunction,
+        fusion.FusedDSv3TF32RouterGateFunction,
+    ):
+        x = activation.detach().requires_grad_(need_input)
+        w = weight.detach().requires_grad_(need_weight)
+        logits = function.apply(
+            x, w, "bf16", torch.float32, torch.float32, "tf32", torch.float32
+        )
+        logits.backward(gradient)
+        assert (x.grad is None) is (not need_input)
+        assert (w.grad is None) is (not need_weight)
+        results.append([value for value in (x.grad, w.grad) if value is not None])
+    exact_pair(*results)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", ["strided", "transposed", "expanded", "unaligned"])
+def test_native_fallback_for_gradient_layout(layout):
+    gradient, weight, activation = _operands()
+    if layout == "strided":
+        storage = gradient.new_empty((4096, 512))
+        storage[:, ::2].copy_(gradient)
+        gradient = storage[:, ::2]
+    elif layout == "transposed":
+        gradient = gradient.t().contiguous().t()
+    elif layout == "expanded":
+        gradient = gradient[:1].expand(4096, -1)
+    elif layout == "unaligned":
+        storage = gradient.new_empty(gradient.numel() + 1)
+        storage[1:].view_as(gradient).copy_(gradient)
+        gradient = storage[1:].view_as(gradient)
+    assert not fusion._supports_gate_backward(gradient, weight, wgrad=False)
+    expected = native_pair(gradient, weight, activation)
+    activation.requires_grad_()
+    weight.requires_grad_()
+    operations = Operations()
+    with operations:
+        logits = fusion.FusedDSv3TF32RouterGateFunction.apply(
+            activation,
+            weight,
+            "bf16",
+            torch.float32,
+            torch.float32,
+            "tf32",
+            torch.float32,
+        )
+        actual = torch.autograd.grad(logits, (activation, weight), gradient)
+    exact_pair(expected, actual)
+    assert not any(
+        ("torchtitan.dsv3_router_gate_tf32_" in name for name in operations.names)
+    )
+
+
+def test_native_fallback_for_policy_and_shape():
+    from torchtitan.models.common.router_gate import RouterGemmConfig
+
+    config = replace(
+        _config(),
+        backward=RouterGemmConfig(
+            input_dtype=torch.float32, compute_mode="fp32", output_dtype=torch.float32
+        ),
+    )
+    gates = models(config)
+    _, _, activation = _operands()
+    gradient = torch.randn((4096, 256), device="cuda")
+    results = []
+    for gate in gates:
+        x = activation.detach().requires_grad_()
+        calls = Operations()
+        with calls:
+            logits = gate(x)
+            results.append(torch.autograd.grad(logits, (x, gate.weight), gradient))
+        assert not any(
+            ("torchtitan.dsv3_router_gate_tf32_" in name for name in calls.names)
+        )
+    exact_pair(*results)
+    assert not fusion._supports_gate_backward(
+        gradient[:32], gates[0].weight, wgrad=False
+    )
+
+
+def test_hooks_preserve_module_boundary():
+    gates = models()
+    _, _, activation = _operands()
+    gradient = torch.randn((4096, 256), device="cuda")
+    calls = []
+    forward_handle = gates[1].register_forward_hook(
+        lambda module, args, out: calls.append("forward")
+    )
+    backward_handle = gates[1].register_full_backward_hook(
+        lambda *args: calls.append("backward")
+    )
+    try:
+        results = []
+        for gate in gates:
+            x = activation.detach().requires_grad_()
+            logits = gate(x)
+            results.append(torch.autograd.grad(logits, (x, gate.weight), gradient))
+        exact_pair(*results)
+        assert calls == ["forward", "backward"]
+    finally:
+        forward_handle.remove()
+        backward_handle.remove()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("score_gradient", [False, True])
+def test_actual_learned_router_with_debug_balancing_disabled(score_gradient):
+    from torchtitan.models.common.moe import TokenChoiceTopKRouter
+
+    config = TokenChoiceTopKRouter.Config(
+        num_experts=256,
+        gate=_config(),
+        num_expert_groups=8,
+        num_limited_groups=4,
+        top_k=8,
+        score_func="sigmoid",
+        route_norm=True,
+        route_scale=2.5,
+        _debug_force_load_balance=False,
+    )
+    native = config.build().to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    candidate = (
+        replace(
+            config,
+            gate=fusion.fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32(config.gate, experimental=True),
+        )
+        .build()
+        .to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    )
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        native.gate.weight.normal_(std=0.015625)
+    candidate.load_state_dict(native.state_dict())
+    _, _, activation = _operands(9191)
+    activation = activation.view(1, 4096, 7168)
+    bias = torch.randn((256,), device="cuda") * 0.02
+    grad_weights = torch.randn((1, 4096, 8), device="cuda") * 0.003
+    grad_scores = torch.randn((1, 4096, 256), device="cuda") * 0.001
+    snapshots = []
+    indices = []
+    for router in (native, candidate):
+        x = activation.detach().requires_grad_()
+        weights, ids, scores = router(x, bias)
+        differentiated = (weights, scores) if score_gradient else (weights,)
+        upstream = (grad_weights, grad_scores) if score_gradient else (grad_weights,)
+        calls = Operations()
+        with calls:
+            gradients = torch.autograd.grad(
+                differentiated, (x, router.gate.weight), upstream
+            )
+        assert all((torch.count_nonzero(value) > 0 for value in gradients))
+        assert calls.names.count("torchtitan.dsv3_router_gate_tf32_wgrad.default") == (

+        kernel = _compile_gate_gemm(wgrad, str(grad_output_TE.device))
+        kernel(
+            *(from_dlpack(value.detach(), assumed_align=16) for value in arguments),
+            cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream(grad_output_TE.device).cuda_stream),
+        )
+        return output_RD
+
+
+def _supports_gate_backward(grad_output_TE, operand_RD, *, wgrad):
+    rows = 4096 if wgrad else 256
+    tensors = (grad_output_TE, operand_RD)
+    return (
+        _CUTEDSL_IMPORT_ERROR is None
+        and _NATIVE_MM is not None
+        and all(
+            type(value) in (torch.Tensor, torch.nn.Parameter, FakeTensor)
+            for value in tensors
+        )
+        and grad_output_TE.shape == (4096, 256)
+        and operand_RD.shape == (rows, 7168)
+        and grad_output_TE.dtype == torch.float32
+        and operand_RD.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and grad_output_TE.is_cuda
+        and grad_output_TE.device == operand_RD.device
+        and all(
+            value.is_contiguous() and not value.is_neg() and not value.is_conj()
+            for value in tensors
+        )
+        and os.environ.get("NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE") != "0"
+        and torch.__version__ == "2.15.0a0+giteecfcac"
+        and (
+            isinstance(grad_output_TE, FakeTensor)
+            or (
+                all(value.data_ptr() % 16 == 0 for value in tensors)
+                and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(grad_output_TE.device) == (10, 3)
+            )
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@torch.library.custom_op(
+    "torchtitan::dsv3_router_gate_tf32_dgrad", mutates_args=(), device_types="cuda"
+)
+def dgrad_op(grad_output_TE: torch.Tensor, weight_ED: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if not _supports_gate_backward(grad_output_TE, weight_ED, wgrad=False):
+        _require_native_gate()
+        return _NATIVE_MM(
+            grad_output_TE.float(),
+            weight_ED.float(),
+            compute_mode="tf32",
+            out_dtype=torch.float32,
+        ).to(weight_ED.dtype)
+    return _gate_gemm(grad_output_TE, weight_ED, wgrad=False)
+
+
+@dgrad_op.register_fake
+def _dgrad_fake(grad_output_TE, weight_ED):
+    return weight_ED.new_empty((grad_output_TE.shape[0], weight_ED.shape[1]))
+
+
+@torch.library.custom_op(
+    "torchtitan::dsv3_router_gate_tf32_wgrad", mutates_args=(), device_types="cuda"
+)
+def wgrad_op(grad_output_TE: torch.Tensor, input_TD: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if not _supports_gate_backward(grad_output_TE, input_TD, wgrad=True):
+        _require_native_gate()
+        return _NATIVE_MM(
+            grad_output_TE.float().t(),
+            input_TD.float(),
+            compute_mode="tf32",
+            out_dtype=torch.float32,
+        ).to(input_TD.dtype)
+    return _gate_gemm(grad_output_TE, input_TD, wgrad=True)
+
+
+@wgrad_op.register_fake
+def _wgrad_fake(grad_output_TE, input_TD):
+    return input_TD.new_empty((grad_output_TE.shape[1], input_TD.shape[1]))
+
+
+class FusedDSv3TF32RouterGateFunction(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """Native forward and two fused cast/TF32-GEMM/BF16-cast backward operators."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(  # pyrefly: ignore[bad-override]
+        ctx,
+        input_TD,
+        weight_ED,
+        forward_compute,
+        forward_output_dtype,
+        backward_input_dtype,
+        backward_compute,
+        backward_output_dtype,
+    ):
+        return _require_native_gate().forward(
+            ctx,
+            input_TD,
+            weight_ED,
+            forward_compute,
+            forward_output_dtype,
+            backward_input_dtype,
+            backward_compute,
+            backward_output_dtype,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @once_differentiable
+    def backward(ctx, grad_output_TE):  # pyrefly: ignore[bad-override]
+        input_TD, weight_ED = ctx.saved_tensors
+        if not (
+            ctx.backward_input_dtype == torch.float32
+            and ctx.backward_compute == "tf32"
+            and ctx.backward_output_dtype == torch.float32
+            and (
+                torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+                or (
+                    _supports_gate_backward(grad_output_TE, weight_ED, wgrad=False)
+                    and _supports_gate_backward(grad_output_TE, input_TD, wgrad=True)
+                )
+            )
+        ):
+            return _require_native_gate().backward(ctx, grad_output_TE)
+        grad_input_TD = (
+            dgrad_op(grad_output_TE, weight_ED) if ctx.needs_input_grad[0] else None
+        )
+        grad_weight_ED = (
+            wgrad_op(grad_output_TE, input_TD) if ctx.needs_input_grad[1] else None
+        )
+        return grad_input_TD, grad_weight_ED, None, None, None, None, None
+
+
+if RouterGateLinear is not None:
+
+    class FusedDSv3TF32RouterGate(RouterGateLinear):
+        forward_config: Any
+        backward_config: Any
+        weight: torch.Tensor
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None
+        out_features: int
+
+        @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+        class Config(RouterGateLinear.Config):
+            use_fused_backward: bool = False
+
+        def __init__(self, config):
+            super().__init__(config)
+            self.use_fused_backward = config.use_fused_backward
+
+        def forward(self, input_BLD):
+            if not self.use_fused_backward:
+                return super().forward(input_BLD)
+            input_shape = input_BLD.shape
+            input_TD = input_BLD.reshape(-1, input_shape[-1])
+            forward = self.forward_config
+            backward = self.backward_config
+            with torch.autocast(device_type=input_BLD.device.type, enabled=False):
+                output_TE = FusedDSv3TF32RouterGateFunction.apply(
+                    input_TD.to(forward.input_dtype),
+                    self.weight.to(forward.input_dtype),
+                    forward.compute_mode,
+                    forward.output_dtype,
+                    backward.input_dtype,
+                    backward.compute_mode,
+                    backward.output_dtype,
+                )
+                if self.bias is not None:
+                    output_TE = output_TE + self.bias.to(forward.output_dtype)
+            return output_TE.reshape(*input_shape[:-1], self.out_features)
+
+else:
+    FusedDSv3TF32RouterGate = None
+
+
+def fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32(cfg, *, experimental=False):
+    """Fuse an existing TF32 gate without changing its numerical policy."""
+    _require_native_gate()
+    if FusedDSv3TF32RouterGate is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("The pinned RouterGateLinear implementation is required.")
+    enabled = ACCEPTED or experimental
+    if not ACCEPTED:
+        warnings.warn(
+            "TF32 router-gate roofline acceptance is open; experimental=True "
+            "enables the candidate. Native backward is the default.",
+            stacklevel=2,
+        )
+    return derive(cfg, FusedDSv3TF32RouterGate.Config, use_fused_backward=enabled)
+
+
+if RouterGateLinear is not None:
+    fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32 = override(
+        target=RouterGateLinear.Config,
+        exact=True,
+        fqns=["*.moe.router.gate"],
+        description="Fuse the DSv3 TF32 router-gate backward with CuTeDSL.",
+    )(fused_dsv3_router_gate_tf32)
